item.title: What is inflation?

item.title: What are interest rates, and why do they change over time?
item.description: The rate of interest is at its’ most basic level, the cost of money. The price you pay to borrow money for a house, car, or business. item.title: What is the role of the Central Bank?
item.description: A country’s Central Bank performs many essential functions of its’ financial system. But at its’ core, the job of the Central Bank is to balance keeping inflation stable and maximizing employment & or growth. This is where the terms ‘Dovish’ and ‘Hawkish’ come from.
